items.quote: The microstructure observation and composition analysis of the sample was measured by scanning electron microscopy (SEM, FEI 450G) with energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDS).
The crystal structure and phase identification of the sample at room temperature was checked by X-ray powder diffraction (XRD, PLXcel 3D, Co Kα radiation).

Thermal analysis measurements of the annealed alloys were investigated in Al2O3 crucibles under a flowing pure N2 atmosphere using differential thermal analysis (DTA, TA Instruments SDT/Q-600). The heating ramp was run at 10 and 20 K/min, respectively.

La and Mn (99.99% purity, China New Metal Materials Technology Company, Ltd.) were used as starting materials. The alloys with the weight about 3 grams were prepared by arc melting pure elements under argon atmosphere using a non-consumable tungsten electrode and re-melted several times in order to achieve complete fusion and good homogeneity.

The ingots were annealed in an evacuated quartz tube at 873 K for 3 weeks.
